title: Official request
summary: A Council official or independent guard asks for bounded help that brings the public address closer to the player's path.
adaptationRule: The request may be refused. If it is, advance the official duty through another actor or let its consequences cross the player's path; never narrate acceptance for the player.

title: Person in need
summary: A person nearby needs immediate, limited help while the public gathering develops around them.
adaptationRule: The player may decline or leave. The need continues independently and may create a later intersection; never force sympathy, aid, or pursuit.

title: Restricted access change
summary: A guard line, ward, closure, or authorization change alters which parts of the Council Crown are presently accessible.
adaptationRule: Change the external routes and available spaces without choosing the player's destination or claiming they obeyed an instruction.

title: Suspicious activity
summary: An observable person, object, or inconsistency moves through the Crown as the public address approaches.
adaptationRule: The player may ignore it. Let the activity proceed causally and surface evidence or consequences later instead of forcing investigation.

title: Minor emergency
summary: A bounded disturbance redirects nearby people and resources without beginning the central attack.
adaptationRule: Keep the emergency proportionate and external. Adapt to avoidance or refusal without escalating it into the First Speaker strike.

title: Public movement
summary: Bells, crowd movement, or a schedule change shifts the public event and alters nearby access.
adaptationRule: Describe what the public and officials do, but leave the player's movement and response entirely to the player.
